_meta.viewport: 1440 x 900 (mobile group 390 x 844); www.helloivy.co paints html[toggle-theme=light] by default and repaints through the footer's own "Change theme" toggle (a real click on the painted control; html[toggle-theme=dark] + localStorage.currentToggleState, verified by the painted surface before any dark reading). app.helloivy.co has no theme control and paints light only; its semantic --*-color layer is the share page's inline section.main_section theme, not the login card's.
